No Lean available in the environment (checked: which lean lake -> none); z3 5.1.0, sympy 1.14.0, PARI/GP, gcc present.

z3 (z3_formalize.py, log z3_formalize.log, ~12 s): For each even D in {2,4,...,60}, with A_0..A_D as UNCONSTRAINED Int variables (so independent of the a_i; only the two facts the proof uses are assumed), define c_n := sum_{t=0}^{D/2} A_{n-2t} (A_m = 0 outside [0,D]) and T_n := sum_i (-1)^i A_{n-i}. Results, all D: (main) A_D = 1 /\ sum(-1)^m A_m = 1 /\ c_{D-1} != c_{D-2} is UNSAT; witness (hyps /\ goal) SAT; dropping A(-1)=1 -> goal can fail (SAT); dropping A_D=1 -> goal can fail (SAT). Unconditional identities (negation UNSAT): S2 for every n <= D+1 (and S2 fails at n = D+2, SAT, as expected); S3 for every 1 <= n <= D+1; S4 T_D = sum(-1)^m A_m; S5 T_{D-1} = A_D - T_D. Plus exhaustive S4c ([a]_{-1} = 1 for odd a <= 2001, 0 for even) and S7 (A_1 = k, A_2 = k + C(k,2) for a_i in 3..9, k <= 7 by exponent-tuple counting).

sympy (sympy_symbolic.py, log sympy_symbolic.log): (I) c_{D-1} - c_{D-2} - (A_D - A(-1)) expands to the zero polynomial in symbolic A_0..A_D for every even D <= 200 — this is steps 2-6 in one identity, valid for arbitrary coefficient sequences. (II) [q^2](1+q+q^2)^k = C(k,1)+C(k,2) = k + C(k,2) symbolically in k; and for all odd a_i in 3..15, k <= 6 the actual products satisfy A_1 = k, A_2 = k + C(k,2), A_D = 1, A(-1) = 1, palindromic, and [a_i]_q == 1+q+q^2 (mod q^3). (III) sum_{t=0}^{2j} (-1)^t = 1 symbolically.

Exhaustive certificates: the sweeps listed above (1,376,264 + 25,497 + 6,419 + 1,281 instances), each asserting the claims with exact arithmetic.

Not formalized / limits: (a) the D-uniform statement is not machine-checked in a proof assistant (no Lean); it is a telescoping-sum identity whose instances D <= 200 are verified symbolically, and the hand argument (sum_{m=0}^{D-1} (-1)^{D-1-m} A_m = A_D - A(-1)) is one line. (b) The general-k facts A_D = 1, palindromicity, A(-1) = 1, A_1 = k, A_2 = k + C(k,2) are standard (monic/palindromic product, [a]_{-1} = 1 for odd a, mod-q^3 reduction) and were verified for bounded ranges plus the symbolic-in-k binomial argument, not for symbolic k in a prover.

Rerunnability of the proof's computational parts: the proof proper (steps 1-7) contains no computation. The Remark (explicitly 'not part of the proof') cites margins.c and verify_ff.py, which are not in the proof file and were not rerun (the explorer folder is off-limits); its 'box' is unspecified. The hypotheses D >= 2 (so n = D-1 >= 1) and 'all a_i odd' are each used and the latter is shown essential by controls (tie fails for every tested multiset containing an even a_i).
